# cloudinary_access_key (Data Source)

Fetches a Cloudinary API access key by sub-account ID and API key. The API secret is never returned by the read API and is therefore not exposed by this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudinary_access_key" "example" {
  sub_account_id = "555asdf0000zxcvb3456qwerty"
  api_key        = "814814814814814"
}

output "key_name" {
  value = data.cloudinary_access_key.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String) The API key to look up.
- `sub_account_id` (String) The ID of the product environment (sub-account) the key belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the access key was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the access key is enabled.
- `name` (String) The name of the access key.
